denali-highway.title: Denali Highway
denali-highway.slogan: Paxson to Cantwell · one way, about 412 km back to the start

waypoints.name: Paxson
waypoints.advice: Paxson is where the day begins. Next is Maclaren Summit.

waypoints.name: Maclaren Summit
waypoints.advice: Maclaren Summit comes up 137 km in. Nothing on this route is higher. Next is Susitna River, mostly downhill.

waypoints.name: Susitna River
waypoints.advice: 275 km in you reach Susitna River. Next is Cantwell.

waypoints.name: Cantwell
waypoints.advice: Cantwell closes the day.

sections.advice: Paxson → Maclaren Summit climbs about 1245 m in 70 km. This is the part worth slowing down for - look through the bends and use the pull-offs.
Maclaren Summit → Susitna River drops about 1245 m over 61 km. Brakes and eyes forward; the views are behind the corners, not in them.
Susitna River → Cantwell is 96 km of getting across. Ride it tidily and keep the enthusiasm for what comes after.

denali-highway.provenance: CURATED FROM THE ARCHIVE: waypoints taken from the named road Denali Highway. Distances between stops are great-circle with a road factor, not a routed measurement - the pipeline replaces them when it routes this line.

scenicChapters.title: Paxson → Maclaren Summit
scenicChapters.narrative: The ground tilts up and stays tilted for 127 km. 1245 m of it, taken steadily rather than in one wall — a steady rhythm suits this better than bursts. The height arrives whether you hurry or not.

scenicChapters.title: Maclaren Summit → Susitna River
scenicChapters.narrative: 110 km that neither climbs nor drops much. The road settles into the ground rather than fighting it. This is where a day makes up time without anyone trying. Third and fourth, and very little else.

denali-highway.story: It goes by way of Maclaren Summit and Susitna River. The highest point is about 1,400 m. It suits an unhurried touring pace.

scenicChapters.title: Paklenica National Park → Plitvice Lakes National Park
scenicChapters.narrative: Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did. Water arrives beside the road and stays for 83 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go.

places-defensive-system-of-zadar-hajduck.story: From Zadar it runs 387 km to Zadar; allow about 6 h 40 of riding. On the way it passes Paklenica National Park, Plitvice Lakes National Park, Hajdučki i Rožanski kukovi and back through Plitvice Lakes National Park. It suits an unhurried touring pace.
